General-equilibrium long-run risks. Prices and risk premia from one
consumption process and one investor.

A discounted cash flow takes expected cash-flows from one model and a
risk premium from another. The two models do not have to agree about
when times are bad. This package prices every claim inside one
economy, so expected cash-flows and the risk premium come from the
same exposure.

Companion to [tidyfinance](https://www.tidy-finance.org/). The
default calibration is Kiku (2006), Table II.

## Install

Python 3.11+.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tlorans/kiku-value-premium-replication.git
cd kiku-value-premium-replication
uv pip install -e .
```

Details and the optional WRDS extras are on
[Installation](reference/installation.qmd).

## Basic example

```python
import lrrcs as lrr

model = lrr.LongRunRisksModel()
res = model.solve()
print(res.summary())

res.compare("value", "growth", market="market").premium
```

Change one input and solve again.

```python
lrr.LongRunRisksModel(gamma=7.5).solve().compare("value", "growth").premium
lrr.LongRunRisksModel(claims={"value": {"phi": 2.6}}).solve().compare("value", "growth").premium
```

Table VII is one call.

```python
print(model.simulate(n_samples=1000, years=74, seed=0).summary())
```

## Models

| Object | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`LongRunRisksModel`](reference/api.qmd#the-model) | Specification. Defaults to Table II. |
| `.solve(method="grid")` | Euler equation on the state grid. |
| `.solve(method="analytical")` | Log-linear solution. Loadings and prices of risk. |
| `.simulate(...)` | Finite-sample moments, the paper's Table VII object. |
| `.replace(...)` | A new model with named parameters changed. |
| `.compare(long, short)` | Spread between two priced claims. |

See the [model](guide/model.qmd) and [solution](guide/solution.qmd)
pages.

## Claims

A claim is a cash-flow stream. The model prices a set of named
claims. Which two of them make a spread is asked after the solve.

| Object | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`ClaimParams`](reference/api.qmd#claims) | Four cash-flow parameters of one claim. |
| [`calibrate_claim`](reference/api.qmd#claims) | Measure those parameters from consumption and dividends. Returns do not enter. |
| [`calibrate_claims`](reference/api.qmd#claims) | The same step for a whole cross-section. |
| [`ClaimParams.from_loading`](reference/api.qmd#claims) | A synthetic claim that differs only in $\phi$. |

See [Calibration](guide/calibration.qmd).

## Data

| Object | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `build_annual_panel` | Growth, value, and market panel, 1930 to 2003. |
| `table_i` / `table_vi_data` | Paper tables from that panel. |
| `load_consumption` | Real per-capita nondurables and services growth. |
